newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia building approvals rise in January.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia building approvals rise in January.

text.p: Australian dwelling unit building approvals rose a seasonally-adjusted 10.4 percent in January to 12,020 from 10,887 in December, compared with 9,810 in January 1996, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said. Economists on average had expected building approvals to rise around 2.0 percent.
The bureau said approvals for other residential units rose 36.7 percent in January, while approvals for private sector houses fell 0.5 percent.
